searchText: Looking at the spec, I cannot figure out when any `ProposerSlashing` and/or `SignedBeaconBlockHeader` objects are created - am I missing something? This came up while I was wondering how to implement the `/v1/beacon/headers` API endpoint Users create proposer slashings and sign block headers locally I guess if it's anywhere it should be in the honest validator guide When creating a signed beacon block, because of the way SSZ hashing works, you can replace the body with its root. The resulting object is a signed beacon block header and the signature remains valid thanks, makes sense now!
